name: miebaka-joshua-portfolio
description: Build and image-optimization tooling for Miebaka Joshua's static portfolio.

scripts.build: npm run validate:content && npm run build:experiments && npm run build:shader && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.audit:dev-tools: npm audit --audit-level=moderate || echo 'Non-blocking: review dev-tool advisories above; shipped dependencies are gated separately.'
scripts.quality: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:budgets && npm run test:lighthouse && npm run audit:shipped && npm run audit:dev-tools
scripts.dev: npm run build:experiments && npm run build:shader && node scripts/serve-static.mjs . 4000
scripts.test: npm run test:content && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:case && npm run test:professional && npm run test:contact-api && npm run test:contact-form && npm run test:motion && npm run build && npm run test:css && npm run test:intent && npm run test:integrity && npm run test:contract
